messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to convert remediation items into owners + timelines for alert noise reduction. Proposed action list:
• dedupe rule for redis-error alerts (owner: sam)
• tune latency threshold for model-inference-slow (owner: jess)
• split paging policy infra vs app (owner: ryan)
• recurring weekly noise sweep (owner: oncall rotation / ops)
Can owners ack and give ETAs? I'll create GH issues and a checklist.

sam: Ack. I can take the redis dedupe rule. ETA: EOD Wed. Need an example payload / sample alert to match on.

jess: I can own inference thresholds. Will need traffic percentiles (p95/p99) for the last 7d — @priya can you paste them?

priya: quick numbers from dashboard: `p95=180ms, p99=520ms` (7d). Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboards/inference

ryan: +1 on splitting pages. Proposal: infra issues -> SEV2 pages, app degradations (user-facing) -> SEV3 pages unless critical. I'll draft the policy doc.

oncall-bot: Reminder: `weekly-noise-sweep` recurring meeting created for Fridays 10:00 UTC. Invite sent to #eng-oncall.

maria: Two primary followups I'll record: (1) sam to open dedupe PR and add unit/integration tests; (2) jess to propose thresholds + canary rollout plan — both due next Friday. Any blockers?

sam: Quick question: dedupe window — 5m, 2m, or 1m? Thinking 2m to cover short bursts without merging distinct incidents. cc @jess

jess: For redis bursts, 2m makes sense. For inference slow spikes, keep 1m window so we don't hide sustained slowdowns.

maria: OK locking windows: redis dedupe=2m, inference window=1m. I'll update the follow-up doc and link GH issues.

ryan: I'll draft paging policy doc by Tue EOD and tag owners in the PR. Will include examples for SEV assignment.

priya: I'll add p95/p99 to the alert evaluation set and run a baseline job before threshold changes so we can compare signal/noise.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/456 — includes dedupe matcher and tests. Assigning reviewers @jess @ryan.

maria: Thanks. When you open the PR, also add a short
